title: Home guide: watching ice melt
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: States of matter (Marvellous Medicine and How Far Can Sound Travel?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 9 (Home practical guide and safety card: ice observation (portal worksheet; adult boils water, never touch steam))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

safety: An adult boils any water; never touch steam
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Put an ice cube on a saucer.
Look closely every 5 minutes for 15 minutes.
Write what you notice each time.
